name: EventAgendaItem
description: One agenda line (day or date range) of a Training event. Training events are simple events (event.is_training=true) extended with an ordered list of agenda lines.

start_date.description: Start date of the line (date only)

end_date.description: Optional end date for a date range; defaults to start_date

description.description: Free-text description of what happens on this line

item_type.description: Agenda item type name from the tenant 'event_agenda_item_types' setting (seeded: In person, Online, Self study)

location.description: Venue text (required for In person lines)

zoom_webinar_id.description: Local zoom_webinar PK attached to an Online line

zoom_meeting_id.description: Local zoom_meeting PK attached to an Online line

speaker_ids.description: Speaker ids for this agenda line, additive to the event-level speaker_ids

sponsor_ids.description: event_sponsor ids for this agenda line, additive to event-level sponsor assignments

sort_order.description: Ordering of lines within the event
